answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to escrow a scarce, slashable bond before earning fees. Auditors compare signed task histories; a fraud proof showing coordinated accounts inventing demand burns each culprit's bond. Even a plume of Sybils stretching to the horizon costs one fresh stake per persona, so the attacker's locked capital scales linearly; honest agents recover theirs. A stake worth a walnut is cheap alone, but not when multiplied.
